rv.q: Come the curtain, the ensemble’s enthusiasm, Noisemaker’s songs, and nine decades of comics splashed across Kenneth MacLeod’s colourful set combine to create a wave of sentiment that – jings, crivvens an’ help ma boab! – proves quite hard to resist.
The rest is just pure dead brilliant.
This is a show to crease your face with a smile from start to finish, laced with thigh-slapping tunes, and enough warm-hearted, barmy adventure to keep young and old entertained this Christmas.

cn.t: This affectionate musical adaptation of the beloved Scottish comic strip earns solid praise for its authenticity, polished production values, and nostalgic charm, with critics noting improvements from its 2019 debut.
